parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

parameters.name: FuzzBucketName
parameters.description: The bucket name for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: FuzzFileSystemName
parameters.description: The NAS file system name for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: HasRisk
parameters.description:
Specifies whether risky files are detected. Valid values:

- **0**: No risks detected.
- **1**: Risky files exist.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The business source. Valid values:
- **OSS**: OSS
- **NAS**: NAS

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The detection status. Valid values:

- **1**: Not scanned.
- **2**: Full scan in progress.
- **3**: Incremental scan in progress.
- **4**: Scanned.
